query:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (
                                SELECT id, parent_id FROM menu_sections WHERE id = $1
                                UNION ALL
                                SELECT ms.id, ms.parent_id
                                FROM menu_sections ms
                                JOIN ancestors a ON a.parent_id = ms.id
                            )
                            SELECT EXISTS(
                                SELECT 1 FROM ancestors WHERE id = $2
                            ) as "exists!"
